parts.name: M3 heat-set insert calibration coupon
parts.notes: Left-to-right: 3.8, 4.0, 4.2, 4.4 mm blind holes; measured STEP outer diameter 4.6 mm. Calibrate insertHoleMm before making insert bosses.
parts.author: sergio.pulido@alodai.com

parts.name: N20 motor saddle
parts.notes: 10x12x25.6 mm N20 envelope +0.3 mm clearance per side. Cap sockets are hole size: calibrate; insertHoleMm from mechanical-parameters.json, 5.7 mm depth; must match the chosen M3 insert datasheet before printing this part. Two bottom M3 insert sockets, using the same calibrated pilot; mount with M3x8 through the 4 mm base.
parts.author: sergio.pulido@alodai.com

parts.name: N20 clamp cap
parts.notes: Flat cap for motor_saddle. Four M3 clearance holes. The cap acts on the saddle walls; final clamp height must be confirmed against the selected motor, not tightened onto a loose motor.
parts.author: sergio.pulido@alodai.com

parts.name: LiPo retaining tray
parts.notes: Fits the BOM largest 4S large 107x35x27 mm battery with 1 mm lateral clearance. Two 3x19 mm strap passages. Floor mounting matches chassis grid. Strap model awaits the BOM.
parts.author: sergio.pulido@alodai.com

parts.name: M3 board standoff
parts.notes: 16 mm stand-off, 7 mm outer diameter, 3.4 mm through hole. No assumed controller hole pattern; final board fixture awaits the BOM.
parts.author: sergio.pulido@alodai.com

parts.name: Open cable routing clip
parts.notes: Open 5 mm routing channel with one M3 screw; structural cable restraint, not decorative wiring. Print flat without supports.
parts.author: sergio.pulido@alodai.com

parts.name: Raised electronics bridge
parts.notes: Printed upside-down: plate on bed, four legs upward. Assembly rotates 180 degrees around X and raises 38 mm. Two calibrated M3 insert sockets per leg; hole size: calibrate. 35 mm under-plate clearance for the largest battery.
parts.author: sergio.pulido@alodai.com

parts.name: Pi 5 and regulator carrier
parts.notes: Pi 5 locating pegs fit 2.7 mm holes on the official 58x49 mm pattern; Pi centre x=-12. Integral 16 mm standoffs and PETG edge latches. Regulator pegs follow the official 18.5 mm hole spacing. No M3 through PCB holes. Latch/peg retention requires physical fit test; reference drawing is not production certified.
parts.author: sergio.pulido@alodai.com

parts.name: PETG chassis base
parts.notes: 160x100x4 mm. M3 clearance grid; motor stations x +/-65, y +/-35. Bridge mounting pattern x +/-37, y +/-29. No M3 fasteners through the Pi PCB. Flat prototype print; validate physical fit.
